title: Lekalo Adapter SDK Compatibility Descriptor
description: Closed descriptive contract (issue #106) of one generated adapter SDK package: the exact `lekalo.target/v1` wire token, the closed ascending set of supported protocol versions (an exact spelling set, never a numeric range), the per-version operation vocabulary, the pinned upstream schema identities and digests, the diagnostic-registry and capability-definition pins, the host-policy prerequisites the package inherits, and the generated test-vector references that qualify the codec. The descriptor grants no permissions, no runtime installation authority, and no host trust; it is generated deterministically from reviewed local contract inputs, carries no timestamps and no host identity, and an independent package version never widens the exact accepted wire set.

schemaVersion.description: The wire-format discriminator of this descriptor generation.

identity.description: The stable contract identity of this descriptor generation.

language.description: The one SDK language this descriptor qualifies.

sdkPackage.description: The public package display name of the described SDK (registry coordinates are documented separately per language).

sdkVersion.description: The independent package version of the described SDK release; it never changes protocol versions and never claims a product version.

wireToken.description: The one target-protocol wire token the SDK speaks.

protocolVersions.description: The exact supported protocol spellings, ascending and closed. Membership is exact-set, never a numeric range; unknown or future versions fail before IR disclosure or callback execution.

operations.description: The closed operation vocabulary per supported protocol version, sorted ascending, one row per declared version; a version absent here is unsupported.

irVersions.description: The pinned IR contract versions the generated capability helpers advertise, ascending and closed.

schemas.description: The pinned upstream wire-contract identities the generated types were rendered from, sorted by identity; generated outputs are consumers of these bytes, never a second source of truth.

diagnosticRegistry.description: The one canonical diagnostic registry the generated diagnostic builders validate against; the SDK projection is never a second source of codes.

capabilityDefinitions.description: The exported capability-definition pin: the reviewed canonical embedded table, its export digest, and the id-sorted per-entry definition versions the generated describe helper may declare.

entriesDigest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON bytes of the entries array.

hostPolicy.description: The host-policy prerequisites the SDK inherits and can never relax: adapters stay confined, read-only by default, and never gain network, shell, or undeclared-write authority through the SDK.

testVectors.description: The generated test-vector references that qualify this codec build, sorted by family then path; a stale or missing vector reference fails the compatibility gate instead of silently qualifying the package.

path.description: Corpus-relative vector path inside the shared adapter-sdk fixture family.

ascending.description: Members are sorted in ascending code-unit order and unique (paired with uniqueItems).

ascendingStrings.description: Members are sorted in ascending code-unit order (paired with uniqueItems).
